h1: Architectural design project for private house facades

blocks.text: Architectural design project for private house facades

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed the architectural design of the facades for a private house. The project included the development of an architectural concept for the exterior appearance of the building, taking into account its existing architecture, proportions, and overall style. The main focus was on creating a modern, harmonious, and visually balanced appearance for the private house. The project involved the development of facade solutions, combinations of finishing materials, color schemes, architectural elements, and exterior details. Particular attention was given to the proportions of the facades and the visual relationship between different parts of the building. Photorealistic 3D visualizations of the facades were created to present the future appearance of the house and allow the architectural concept, materials, colors, and exterior solutions to be evaluated before implementation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) provides architectural facade design and photorealistic 3D exterior visualization services for private houses in Slovakia and across Europe.
